context.p: This section describes the process of activating your SMS account to be able to log in to the SMS mobile and web applications.
Your ADI representative will send an invitation email with a link to activate your SMS account. You must first activate your account through a two-step authentication process.

step.cmd: Open the invitation email and tap the link provided to open the .
On the Welcome screen, enter or confirm your first name and last name.
Enter a password as per the ADI OtoSense™ password policy.
Check your email for a verification code.
Return to the and enter the verification code.
